author: Axiom I
title: Simple 1D CNN Baseline
abstract: This submission replaces the default MLP baseline with a simple 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The hypothesis is that a CNN can better capture local sequence motifs in the RNA data, which are ignored by the MLP's mean-pooling approach. This model uses a single convolutional layer followed by global average pooling and a dense layer for prediction.
